RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, November 22, 2012/Agrahayana 1, 1934 (Saka)
————
(Ministries :  Prime Minister; Atomic Energy; Development of North Eastern
Region; External Affairs; Finance; Overseas Indian Affairs; Panchayati Raj;
Parliamentary Affairs; Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions;
Planning; Space; Steel; Tourism; Tribal Affairs; Urban
Development; Youth Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions — 20
Need for a conducive climate for
investment
*1. SHRI D.P. TRIPA THI: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is an
urgent need for opening up of educational
sector and overhauling the financial sector
to create a conducive climate for
investment; and
(b) if so, the action Government is
taking in this regard?
Lower growth rate of GDP in 2011-12
*2. SHRI VIJAY JAWAHARLAL
DARDA: Will the Minister of FINANCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the then Chief Economic
Advisor of the Ministry stated in January,
2012, that the expected growth rate in
2011-12 fiscal year, would be slightly
above 7 per cent;
(b) if so, the reasons for difference of
1.4 per cent, when compared with GDP of
8.4 per cent during 2010-11;
(c) whether higher GDP has been
achieved in 2010-11 due to high growth in
transport, storage, communication (14.7
per cent), financial, insurance, real estate,
business service (10.4 per cent) and trade,
hotels (9 per cent);
(d) whether such contribution has gone
down during 2011-12; and
(e) if not, the other factors responsible
for 2011-12 GDP lower than that of
2010-11?
Rebate on agricultural loans to
farmers
*3. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has given
rebate on re-scheduled agricultural loans

2
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
to farmers of drought-hit States in the
country;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the number of farmers given such
rebate in the State of Maharashtra, district-
wise?
Measures to tackle inflation
*4. SHRI PRAKASH JAV ADEKAR:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be pleased
to state:
(a) the figures of inflation Consumer
Price Index, month-wise, since 2009;
(b) the reasons for rising inflation;
(c) the action that Government has
taken to curb rising inflation till date and
the impact of such measures; and
(d) the action it proposes to take to
tackle rising inflation?
Research findings through National
Space  Policy
*5. DR. E.M. SUDARSANA
NATCHIAPPAN: W ill the PRIME
MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Department of Space
has a "National Space Policy" through
which the huge needs of  the Indian citizens
in collecting, distributing, conducting
research and delivering productive findings
are addressed to; and
(b) if so, the patents that are filed on
the basis of said research findings and
processes in health related issues?
Report of Mahapatra Committee on
Debt Recast
*6. SHRI D. RAJA: Will the Minister
of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the RBI
appointed Mahapatra Committee on Debt
Recast has observed that there has been an
extraordinary rise in the level of
restructured standard assets even
surpassing the quantum of gross Non-
Performing Assets (NPA) of the banking
sector and the credibility of the Indian
banking system is at stake; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and
Government's reaction thereto?
Permanent membership of Security
Council
†*7. SHRI MOHAN SINGH: Will the
Minister of EXTERNAL AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether India is pressing upon a
proposal of expanding the Security Council
and including therein countries from Asia,
Africa and Latin America;
(b) whether the developed and big
nations of the world are also supporting
this proposal of India; and
(c) the number of countries of the world
which have supported India's permanent
membership in Security Council?
Video recording of Gram Sabha in
Panchayats
†*8. SHRI ISHWARLAL
SHANKARLAL JAIN: Will the Minister
of PANCHAYATI RAJ be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has issued
guidelines to State Governments to make
compulsory video recording of Gram
Sabha in Panchayats;
(b) whether the Central Government
would provide any separate amount to
Panchayats for this work, or the amount
may be provided for video recording in the
name of administrative expenditure;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether information about
meetings of Gram Sabha keeps coming in

3
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
from each State through Collector;
and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Reduction in Government expenses
†*9. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has decided to
reduce various Government expenses in
view of huge difference between the
budgetary economic estimates during the
financial year 2012-13;
(b) if so, the details of such expenses
and whether any priority has been set in
the det
